Proof done. `/work/putnam_2006_a4.lean` compiles with no errors and no `sorry` warning. The only remaining warning is an unused-variable lint on the original statement's binder `p` at line 21, which I left alone.

Approach: swap-based bijections on permutations. For distinct positions, swapping two positions maps the set "position x is larger than position y" onto the set with the roles exchanged, so those counts are equal. Three positions always have exactly one maximum, so an interior position is a local max in n!/3 permutations. An endpoint is a local max in n!/2. Summing over positions gives 3·∑ pcount = (n+1)·n!, and dividing by n! gives (n+1)/3.

Only the proof body changed. The imports, statement, and `_solution` definition are untouched, and there are no axioms, `native_decide`, `#eval`, or metaprogramming.
